## DotOS v0.2.2

Same firmware as v0.2.1 (no on-device behaviour change) plus packaging and
onboarding polish.

### New
- **[Installation guide](https://github.com/Holrigue/ARGUS-DotOS/blob/main/INSTALL.md)** —
  a plain, step-by-step guide to flash the watch from the browser in a few
  minutes, set up the SD-card assets, and pair the companion app.

### Housekeeping
- The browser **flasher is now branded DotOS** (the old "ARGUS" / "13:37"
  flashers are gone).
- Release assets renamed to `dotos-<tag>-sdcard.zip`.
- GitHub's auto **"Source code" archive is slimmed** to what actually builds the
  firmware (dev-only trees like `sim/`, `test/`, `docs/` are kept in the repo but
  dropped from the downloadable source zip).

### Flashing
New to DotOS? Start with the **[Installation guide](https://github.com/Holrigue/ARGUS-DotOS/blob/main/INSTALL.md)**.
Otherwise: open **`DotOS-v0.2.2-flasher.html`** below in Chrome or Edge, plug the
watch in over USB-C, hold **BOOT** while connecting, and click **Flash**. Decline
the full erase to keep your settings.

Everything in v0.2.1 is included: gentler alarm/call ring, the call **Hang up**
button, the alarm/timer setup no longer bouncing to the clock, the Offense
double opt-in (no more red frame), the Cyan + Pip-Boy green accents, and the
Health screen's blank Stress row removed.
